goal: Implement autonomous 24/7 Quantitative Signal Scanner and Market Data Cache Refresher in telegram_bot.py and engine.py

contracts.interfaces: run_quantitative_signal_scanner function signature and market_data_cache sync
function_signatures: run_quantitative_signal_scanner(sb: Any, notifier: TelegramNotifier, market_map: Dict[str, float], change_map: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]

execution_steps: Write test in test_signal_scanner_worker.py verifying quantitative scanner evaluates coins, persists signals to Supabase, and cache_market_data is invoked
Run python test_signal_scanner_worker.py to verify failure (red phase)
Implement run_quantitative_signal_scanner in telegram_bot.py and link to engine.py evaluation
Add periodic market_data_cache refresh in telegram_bot.py market cycle
Run python test_signal_scanner_worker.py to verify green phase
Run lint and typecheck verification commands
acceptance_criteria: run_quantitative_signal_scanner evaluates market tickers and produces structured signals
BUY/SELL signals are persisted to Supabase signals table via sb.save_signal or persist_signal_to_supabase
Market data is cached to market_data_cache in Supabase with valid TTL

rollback.command: git checkout HEAD -- telegram_bot.py engine.py; rm -f test_signal_scanner_worker.py contracts/TSK-CLOUD-008.contract.json
